tasks.request: Write a function `normalize_email(raw)` that lowercases the address, strips surrounding whitespace, removes any `+tag` suffix from the local part (the text between the first `+` and the `@`), and raises `ValueError('invalid email')` if there is no `@`. Include a pytest test.
Write `is_valid_isbn13(code)` that accepts hyphens, uses the ISBN-13 checksum (digits weighted 1 and 3 alternately, total divisible by 10), and returns a bool. Include a pytest test.

Write `roman_to_int(s)` that converts a Roman numeral between 1 and 3999 (using `I`, `V`, `X`, `L`, `C`, `D`, `M`) to an integer and raises `ValueError` for invalid numerals such as 'IIII'. Include a pytest test.
tests: assert roman_to_int('III') == 3 and roman_to_int('IV') == 4 and roman_to_int('IX') == 9

tasks.request: Write `chunk_list(items, size)` that splits a list into consecutive chunks of `size` and returns a list of lists (the last chunk may be shorter). Raise `ValueError` if `size` < 1. Include a pytest test.

Write `merge_intervals(intervals)` that takes a list of `[start, end]` pairs, merges every pair that overlaps or touches (end == next start), and returns a list of `[start, end]` lists sorted by start. Include a pytest test.

Write `class LRUCache` with `__init__(self, capacity)`, `get(key)` that returns the value or -1 when the key is missing, and `put(key, value)` that evicts the least recently used key when `capacity` is exceeded. Both `get` and `put` count as a use. Include a pytest test.
tests: c = LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); assert c.get(1) == 1; c.put(3, 3); assert c.get(2) == -1; c.put(4, 4); assert c.get(1) == -1; assert c.get(3) == 3; assert c.get(4) == 4
c = LRUCache(1); c.put(1, 1); c.put(1, 5); assert c.get(1) == 5; c.put(2, 2); assert c.get(1) == -1
c = LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 'a'); c.put(2, 'b'); c.put(1, 'c'); c.put(3, 'd'); assert c.get(2) == -1 and c.get(1) == 'c'

tasks.request: Write `validate_password(pw)` that returns True only if the password has at least 12 characters, an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and at least one of the symbols `!@#$`; otherwise return False. Include a pytest test.

Write `parse_iso_date(s)` that parses a `YYYY-MM-DD` string into a `datetime.date` and raises `ValueError` for a month outside 1-12, a day that does not exist in that month, or any other malformed string. Include a pytest test.

Write `celsius_to_fahrenheit(c)` and `fahrenheit_to_celsius(f)` that round the result to 2 decimals and raise `ValueError` for temperatures below absolute zero (-273.15 C / -459.67 F). Include a pytest test.

Write `word_frequency(text, top_n=3)` that lowercases the text, ignores punctuation, and returns a list of `(word, count)` tuples for the `top_n` most frequent words, ordered by count descending and then alphabetically. Include a pytest test.
tests: assert word_frequency('the cat and the hat and the bat') == [('the', 3), ('and', 2), ('bat', 1)]

tasks.request: Write `camel_to_snake(name)` that converts `camelCase` and `PascalCase` identifiers to `snake_case`, keeping acronyms together (`HTTPResponseCode` -> `http_response_code`). Include a pytest test.
Write `is_balanced(s)` that returns True if the brackets `()`, `[]` and `{}` in the string are balanced and correctly nested, ignoring every other character. Include a pytest test.

Write `fizzbuzz(n)` that returns a list of strings for the numbers 1 to `n`: 'Fizz' for multiples of 3, 'Buzz' for multiples of 5, 'FizzBuzz' for multiples of both, otherwise the number as a string. Return `[]` for `n` = 0 and raise `ValueError` for negative `n`. Include a pytest test.
Write `binary_search(items, target)` that returns the index of `target` in the sorted list `items`, or -1 if it is not present. Include a pytest test.
Write `flatten(nested)` that recursively flattens arbitrarily nested lists into a single flat list, keeping strings whole (do not split 'ab' into characters). Include a pytest test.
Write `dedupe_preserve_order(items)` that returns a new list with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence of each item in its original order. Include a pytest test.
tests: x = [1, 1, 2]; y = dedupe_preserve_order(x); assert x == [1, 1, 2] and y == [1, 2]

tasks.request: Write `class MinStack` with `push(x)`, `pop()` (removes and returns the top value), `top()` and `get_min()`, all O(1); `pop()` and `top()` on an empty stack raise `IndexError`. `get_min()` returns the smallest value currently on the stack. Include a pytest test.
tests: s = MinStack(); s.push(5); s.push(3); s.push(7); assert s.get_min() == 3 and s.top() == 7
s = MinStack(); s.push(5); s.push(3); s.push(7); assert s.pop() == 7 and s.pop() == 3 and s.get_min() == 5 and s.top() == 5
s = MinStack(); s.push(2); s.push(2); s.pop(); assert s.get_min() == 2

tasks.request: Write `luhn_check(number)` that returns True if a string of digits (spaces allowed) passes the Luhn checksum and False otherwise, including for any string containing other characters. Include a pytest test.
Write `slugify(text)` that lowercases the text, replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single `-`, and strips leading and trailing `-`. Include a pytest test.

Write `parse_csv_line(line)` that splits one CSV line into a list of fields, honouring double-quoted fields that contain commas and treating a doubled quote `""` inside quotes as a literal quote. Include a pytest test.
